# Style 01 · Quiet Luxury

> Restraint as the signal of value.

**Keywords:** Understated · Timeless · Considered · Tactile · Calm  
**Mood:** Premium · Calm · Minimal  
**Sectors:** Luxury & fashion · Real estate · Hospitality & travel · Beauty & wellness · Finance & professional services  
**Strongest applications:** Brand identity · Print & editorial · Websites · Packaging · Social media

> **Fictional sample brand.** Maison Velline, fine jewelry house, and every person, figure and address in its examples are invented to demonstrate this style. This is not client work. Domains use the reserved `.example` TLD.

## Concept

Quiet Luxury sells through what it leaves out. Large margins, a narrow muted palette and a high-contrast serif tell the audience the brand has nothing to prove. Product is shown slowly and in isolation, and copy is short enough to be read as a caption.

## Target industries

- Fine jewelry and watches
- Fashion and leather goods
- Premium real estate
- Boutique hotels and spas
- Private banking
- Fragrance and beauty

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Pearl | `#EEEBE6` | Primary background | 60% |
| Onyx | `#1A1918` | Text, logo, dark sections | 22% |
| Greige | `#B5ADA3` | Dividers, secondary surfaces | 8% |
| Mink | `#6E655C` | Secondary text, captions | 6% |
| Champagne | `#B49A6A` | Single accent: rules, small marks | 4% |

**Rule:** Champagne is a detail colour. Use it for a hairline, a monogram or an underline, never for a filled button or a large block.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Cormorant Garamond** | 300, 500 · italic 400 | Headlines, product names, pull quotes |
| Body | **Jost** | 300, 400, 500 | Body copy, navigation, buttons (uppercase, tracked) |
| Arabic | **Amiri (display) · Noto Naskh Arabic (body)** | | Keep Arabic headlines in a classical Naskh for a calm, literary tone. Do not use a heavy Kufi. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 72 / 76 | 300 | Sentence case, -1% tracking |
| H1 | 48 / 54 | 300 | Italic allowed for one word |
| H2 | 28 / 34 | 500 | Sentence case |
| Body | 16 / 28 | 300 | Max 60 characters per line |
| Label | 11 / 16 | 500 | Uppercase, +18% tracking |

- Use the light weight for headlines. Bold weights look commercial.
- Italicise one word in a headline, never a full sentence.
- Set all buttons and labels in small tracked uppercase.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 12 columns · 32px gutter · 120px outer margin on desktop
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Section spacing 160px desktop, 96px mobile.
- **Corners:** 0. Arched top only on hero imagery.

- Leave at least 40% of every layout empty.
- Show one product or one idea per screen or slide.
- Align text flush left on a narrow column, offset from the image.
- Use hairline rules (1px Greige) to separate content, not boxes.
- Put the logo small and centred. It does not need to compete.

## Photography direction

Still-life and slow portraiture with soft daylight, tonal backgrounds and room to breathe.

- Natural side light from one window, with soft shadow.
- Tonal sets: stone, linen, plaster in the palette colours.
- Close crops on texture: stitching, metal, skin.
- Models look away from camera. No posed smiles.
- Grade warm and slightly desaturated. Keep blacks soft.

**Sample shot list**

1. Ring on travertine, raking window light (grade: `#D8D0C4` → `#A79C8E` → `#5E554C`)
2. Hand in linen sleeve, shallow focus (grade: `#E6E0D8` → `#C2B6A6` → `#7A6E62`)
3. Empty hotel suite, late afternoon (grade: `#CFC4B4` → `#8E8173` → `#2E2A27`)

**Avoid**

- Hard flash and glossy reflections
- Busy props and lifestyle clutter
- Saturated colour backdrops

## Graphic elements

- Hairline frames with generous inner padding
- Arched image masks for hero visuals
- Monogram mark used as a watermark at 4% opacity
- Thin Champagne rule under section titles (40px wide)
- Numbered collection captions: N° 01, N° 02

## UI examples

- Buttons are text with a hairline border. Primary is filled Onyx.
- Inputs are a single bottom rule, no box.
- Cards have no shadow and no radius. Space separates them.
- Hover states change underline or opacity, never colour jumps.

- Primary button: `Book a private viewing` · Secondary button: `View collection`
- Input: Email address: `client@example.com`
- Tags: `18k gold` `Ethically sourced` `Made to order`
- Card: **The Solène Ring**, N° 04 · Yellow gold, From 4,200 EUR

## Social media examples

- One product, one line of copy. Logo small at the bottom.
- Alternate product stills with texture close-ups to make a calm grid.
- Stories use the same stills with slow zoom, no stickers.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed post 1080 × 1080 | N° 04 | Made to be kept. |  |
| Story 1080 × 1920 | Atelier | Sixty hours. One ring. | Discover |
| Feed ad 1080 × 1350 | Private appointments | Visit the atelier | Book a viewing |

## Website example

- Hero: one arched image and a short headline, nothing else above the fold.
- Navigation in small tracked caps, centred logo.
- Long-scroll storytelling with alternating image and text.

- **Navigation:** Collections · Atelier · Appointments
- **Hero eyebrow:** Spring collection
- **Hero headline:** Pieces made to be kept.
- **Hero copy:** Hand-finished in our Paris atelier, each piece is made to order and signed by its maker.
- **Actions:** Explore the collection / Our atelier
- **Proof row:** Made to order (Every piece is made for one client.) · Lifetime care (Free polishing and resizing, forever.) · Private viewings (By appointment in Paris and Dubai.)

## Advertising campaign

**Campaign:** Made to Be Kept

Each execution isolates one piece on stone with a single line about permanence. The scarcity of words is the message.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Billboard 48-sheet (6096 × 3048 mm) | Maison Velline · Paris | Made to be kept. | maisonvelline.example |
| Display MPU 300 × 250 and leaderboard 728 × 90 | | Private viewings, by appointment. | Book |

- Billboards carry one image and five words at most.
- Book premium districts, airports and hotel lobbies. Avoid cluttered roadside sites.
- Digital banners use the same still with a slow 6-second zoom and no other animation.

## Presentations

- **Cover slide:** Brand presentation · 2027 · **The Solène collection** · Launch plan for Paris and Dubai
- **Content slide:** Who we are designing for. Key figure **35–55** (core collector age range); points: Buy once, keep for decades; Expect privacy, not promotion; Visit by appointment. Figures are sample data.

- One idea per slide, set in the light display weight.
- Full-bleed stills between sections to slow the pace.
- Charts in Onyx and Greige only. Champagne marks the key value.

## Brand applications

Business card, letterhead and email signature for **Camille Roux**, Client Director (`camille@maisonvelline.example`, fictional).

| Application | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Packaging | Pearl rigid box, blind-embossed monogram, Champagne grosgrain ribbon |
| Stationery | cotton paper, Onyx letterpress, no full-colour printing |
| Retail | plaster walls, one spotlight per vitrine |
| Signage | brushed brass monogram, never illuminated letters |

- The monogram works alone at small sizes. The full wordmark needs 40mm width or more.
- Print with one or two inks plus blind embossing.
- Touch matters: specify paper weight and finish on every print job.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Let one image fill the frame | Discount badges or urgency copy |
| Use italics for emphasis | More than one accent colour |
| Keep copy under 12 words per frame | Drop shadows or gradients |
